Bruges ( / b r uː ʒ / ⓘ BROOZH , French: [bʁyʒ] ⓘ ; Dutch : Brugge [ˈbrʏɣə] ⓘ ; West Flemish : Brugge [ˈbrœɦə] ) is the capital and largest city of the province of West Flanders , in the Flemish Region of Belgium . It is located in the northwest of the country, and is the sixth most populous city in Belgium.  The predominant language is Dutch ( West Flemish ).
